arxiv-2012-12597.title: Superconductivity in dilute system of sites with strong electron-electron attraction
arxiv-2012-12597.creator: A. Yu. Zyuzin
arxiv-2012-12597.description: Abstract We consider the effect of strong electron-electron attraction on superconductivity in the dilute system of the negative U-centers. They couple to the conducting electronic states and mediate attraction between electrons. We predict the formation of the local Cooper pairs provided attraction exceeds a certain threshold value.

arxiv-2105-14723.description: Abstract We perform a systemical investigation of the low-lying doubly-heavy dibaryon systems with strange S = 0 S=0 , isospin I = 0 I=0 , 1 1 , 2 2 and the angular momentum J = 0 J=0 , 1 1 , 2 2 , 3 3 in the quark delocalization color screening model.

arxiv-2201-11954.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by François G. Meyer. We address the following foundational question: what is the population, and sample, Frechet mean (or median) graph of an ensemble of inhomogeneous Erdős-Rényi random graphs? arxiv-2203-00345.title: The role of polymer structure on water confinement in poly( N -isopropylacrylamide) dispersions Journal: -
arxiv-2203-00345.creator: E. Buratti, L. Tavagnacco, M. Zanatta, E. Chiessi, S. Buoso, S. Franco, B. Ruzicka, R. Angelini, A. Orecchini, M. Bertoldo, E. Zaccarelli
arxiv-2203-00345.description: Abstract Poly( N -isopropylacrylamide) (PNIPAM) is a synthetic polymer that is widely studied for its thermoresponsive character. However, recent works also reported evidence of a low temperature (protein-like) dynamical transition around 225 K in concentrated PNIPAM suspensions, independently of the polymer architecture, i.e., both for linear chains and for microgels.

arxiv-2211-17029.title: Directed Acyclic Graph Structure Learning from Dynamic Graphs
arxiv-2211-17029.creator: Shaohua Fan, Shuyang Zhang, Xiao Wang, Chuan Shi
arxiv-2211-17029.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Shaohua Fan, Shuyang Zhang, Xiao Wang, Chuan Shi. Estimating the structure of directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) of features (variables) plays a vital role in revealing the latent data generation process and providing causal insights in various applications. Although there have been many studies on structure learning with various types of data, the structure learning on the dynamic graph has not been explored yet, and thus we study the learning problem of node feature generation mechanism on such ubiquitous dynamic graph data.

arxiv-2303-08753.title: The electron-proton bound state in the continuum with the positive binding energy of 1.531 of the electron mass.
arxiv-2303-08753.description: Abstract In the bound states in the continuum (BIC) the binding energy is positive, and the mass of a composite particle is greater than the total mass of its constituents. In this work the BIC state is studied for the electron-proton system with using the ladder Bethe-Salpeter equation.

arxiv-2403-19921.creator: Lucas Falcão on behalf of the LHCb Collaboration

arxiv-2409-08918.title: Entropic uncertainty relations and quantum Fisher information of top quarks in a large hadron collider
arxiv-2409-08918.creator: Biao-Liang Ye, Li-Yuan Xue, Zhi-Qiang Zhu, Dan-Dan Shi, Shao-Ming Fei
arxiv-2409-08918.description: Abstract We employ the entropic uncertainty relations and the quantum Fisher information to explore the formation of quark t ​ t ¯ t\bar{t} pairs at a large hadron collider through the combination of q ​ q ¯ q\bar{q} pair and g ​ g gg pair initiated processes.

arxiv-2502-10997.title: Improved Regret in Stochastic Decision-Theoretic Online Learning under Differential Privacy
arxiv-2502-10997.creator: Ruihan Wu, Yu-Xiang Wang
arxiv-2502-10997.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ruihan Wu, Yu-Xiang Wang. Hu and Mehta (2024) posed an open problem: what is the optimal instance-dependent rate for the stochastic decision-theoretic online learning (with K K actions and T T rounds) under ε \varepsilon -differential privacy?

arxiv-2502-21283.title: Reconstruction of spider system’s observables from orbital period modulations via the Applegate mechanism
arxiv-2502-21283.creator: Vittorio De Falco, Amodio Carleo, Alessandro Ridolfi, Alessandro Corongiu
arxiv-2502-21283.description: Abstract Redback and black widow pulsars are two classes of peculiar binary systems characterized by very short orbital periods, very low mass companions, and, in several cases, regular eclipses in their pulsed radio signal. Long-term timing revealed systematic but unpredictable variations in the orbital period, which can most likely be explained by the so-called Applegate mechanism.

arxiv-2503-00791.title: Expandora: Broadening Design Exploration with Text-to-Image Model Conference: Extended Abstracts of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; April 26-May 1, 2025; Yokohama, Japan Extended Abstracts of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI EA ’25), April 26-Ma
arxiv-2503-00791.creator: DaEun Choi, Kihoon Son, Hyunjoon Jung, Juho Kim
arxiv-2503-00791.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by DaEun Choi, Kihoon Son, Hyunjoon Jung, Juho Kim. Broad exploration of references is critical in the visual design process. While text-to-image (T2I) models offer efficiency and customization of exploration, they often limit support for divergence in exploration. We conducted a formative study (N=6) to investigate the limitations of current interaction with the T2I model for broad exploration and found that designers struggle to articulate exploratory intentions and manage iterative, non-linear workflows. To address these challenges, we developed Expandora.

arxiv-2601-07962.title: The Veronese Geometry of Dziobek Configurations and Generic Finiteness for Homogeneous Potentials
arxiv-2601-07962.creator: Thiago Dias
arxiv-2601-07962.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Thiago Dias. The main contribution of this paper is the proof of the generic finiteness of Dziobek central configurations for a homogeneous potential and the derivation of a uniform upper bound for their number. By exploiting the isomorphism between the Veronese variety and the determinantal variety associated with the Dziobek conditions, we define the Dziobek-Veronese variety and apply the dimension of fibers theorem to analyze the projection from the space of configurations and masses to the space of masses.

As part of a demographic surveillance system in northern Malawi in 2002-6, covering a popul

pmc-10580314.title: High-Mobility and Bias-Stable Field-Effect Transistors Based on Lead-Free Formamidinium Tin Iodide Perovskites

Here, we report an additive engineering strategy to realize high-performance and stable field-effect transistors (FETs) based on 3D formamidinium tin iodide (FASnI3) films. By comparatively studying the modification effects of two additives, i.e.

pmc-11371410.title: Mangrove Health Index, Community Structure and Canopy Cover in Small Islands of Bunaken National Park, Indonesia: Insights into Dominant Mangrove Species and Overall Mangrove Condition
pmc-11371410.creator: Joshian Nicolas William Schaduw, Trina Ekawati Tallei, Deiske A Sumilat
pmc-11371410.description: Mangrove ecosystems are crucial for protecting littoral regions, preserving biodiversity and sequestering carbon. The implementation of effective conservation and management strategies requires a comprehensive understanding of mangrove community structure, canopy coverage and overall health. This investigation focused on four small islands located within the Bunaken National Park in Indonesia: Bunaken, Manado Tua, Mantehage and Nain.

pmc-11681872.title: Effects of glucocorticoids on postoperative delirium in patients undergoing elective non-cardiac surgery:A systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11681872.creator: Zicen Li, Jing Lu, Di Wang, Liping Han
pmc-11681872.description: BackgroundPostoperative delirium (POD) is common postoperative complications in non-cardiac surgery. While delirium prophylaxis has not yielded unequivocal support. The clinical effects of glucocorticoids on POD remains unclear.ObjectiveTo evaluate the effects of glucocorticoids on postoperative delirium (POD) in patients undergoing non-cardiac surgery.DesignSystematic review with meta-analysis.

pmc-12764309.title: Siji Kangbingdu Mixture Ameliorates LPS-Induced Acute Lung Injury by Downregulating the TNF/IL-17 Signaling Pathways: A Comprehensive Study Using Transcriptomics, Network Pharmacology and Experimental Verification
pmc-12764309.creator: Yuan Wang, Huiying Zhou, Bo Wang, Yuxi Liu, Kaihua Long, Hong Zhang
pmc-12764309.description: BackgroundAcute lung injury (ALI), as a respiratory condition triggered by various internal and external factors, is characterized clinically by high rates of incidence and mortality. In the current context where respiratory system diseases are on the rise, the incidence of ALI has been increasing annually. Previous research has established the efficacy of traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) in inhibiting ALI.

pmc-12952603.title: Investigating key drivers influencing AI-based detection and identification of plants
pmc-12952603.creator: Andréanne Charron, Adèle Julien, Joseph R. Stinziano, Marie-Claude Gagnon
pmc-12952603.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). In recent years, AI-driven platforms have transformed citizen science by collecting and generating valuable records of living organisms for monitoring biological data. Many applications utilize visual similarity and geospatial information to identify species based on photographs. This study investigates how location impacts plant identifications made by iNaturalist, particularly in detecting invasive alien plants (IAP) that are not established in an area. We also compare the accuracy of iNaturalist and PlantNet while exploring potential biases.

pmc-13075408.title: Design, Modeling, Self-Calibration and Grasping Method for Modular Cable-Driven Parallel Robots
pmc-13075408.creator: Wanlin Mai, Yonghe Wang, Zhiquan Yang, Bin Zhu, Lin Liu, Jianqing Peng
pmc-13075408.description: Cable-driven parallel robots (CDPRs) are attractive for large-space manipulation because of their lightweight structure, large workspace, and reconfigurability. However, existing systems still face three practical challenges: limited modularity of the mechanical architecture, repeated calibration after reconfiguration, and insufficient integration between visual perception and grasp execution.

pmc-13100205.title: Ontology-driven association rule mining for biomedical entity relationships: integrating hierarchical knowledge to improve gene-disease discovery
pmc-13100205.creator: Mian Athar Naqash, Muhammad Amin, Jamal Uddin, Hany S. Hussein, Ali Raza, Wajdi Alghamdi, Hala AbdelHameed Mostafa, Hend Khalid Alkahtani
pmc-13100205.description: Reliable links between genes and diseases are central to biomedical research; however, many computational methods overlook the semantic and hierarchical layers of ontologies, missing indirect relationships and producing shallow association scores. We propose an ontology-driven framework for gene–disease association mining that integrates hierarchical knowledge from the Gene Ontology and Disease Ontology.

pmc-13192178.title: Benchmarking component choices for unpaired single cell RNA and epigenomic integration
pmc-13192178.creator: Fnu Naqing, Qiuyue Yuan, Zhana Duren
pmc-13192178.description: BackgroundSingle-cell multi-omics sequencing technologies enable profiling various cellular aspects, offering valuable biological insights. Integrating unpaired multi-omics data, which involves profiling different modalities from distinct cells within the same overall population, remains challenging yet crucial for a comprehensive understanding of cell states and molecular dynamics.

pmc-13408822.title: p53 and p21 Status Influences Cellular Response to Metformin in KRAS-Mutant HCT116 Colorectal Cancer Cells
pmc-13408822.creator: Asma Saeed, Jamila Hijazi, Zainab Bashir, Pierre Khoueiry, Assaad A. Eid, Nadine Darwiche, Maria Teresa Bengoechea-Alonso, Johan Ericsson, Borbala I. Mifsud, Georges Nemer
pmc-13408822.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Colorectal cancer (CRC) remains a leading cause of cancer morbidity worldwide, highlighting the need for improved therapies. Metformin, a widely used antihyperglycemic agent, has gained attention for its potential antitumor properties. In this study, we evaluated the effects of the tumor suppressor genes TP53 and CDKN1A on metformin responsiveness in a KRAS-mutant CRC in vitro model using HCT116 cells harboring a G13D mutation in KRAS.

pmc-13550037.title: Adapting a mental health program for people with multiple myeloma and smouldering myeloma: a consumer-informed feasibility study
pmc-13550037.creator: Natalie Tuckey, Matthew Iasiello, Melissa Cantley, Joep van Agteren, Hayley Beer, Daniel B Fassnacht, Imogen Ramsey, Laura C Edney, Rayan Saleh Moussa, Luke Grundy, Mark Ryan, Kathina Ali, Hannah R Wardill
pmc-13550037.description: Consumer involvement in mental health interventions is recognised as essential to producing research that is relevant, acceptable, and ultimately more effective. Here, we report on a mixed-method pilot study to evaluate the suitability of an existing mental health program for people living with incurable blood cancer, multiple myeloma, and precursor form, smouldering multiple myeloma.
